This module implements a high-performance, thread-safe Least Recently Used (LRU) cache
with Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration support. It includes comprehensive error handling,
performance monitoring, and a full pytest test suite.

Features:
- Configurable maxsize for maximum cache capacity
- Configurable ttl (in seconds) for automatic entry expiration

- Customizable key and value serialization (optional)

    hash map provides O(1) lookup by key.
